history.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is RILEY, a 24-year-old woman with natural, slender, unslimmed proportions. She has a soft, pretty face with faint freckles, warm brown eyes and straight dark brows. She wears thin, round silver wire-rimmed glasses. Her auburn-brown hair is pulled back into a low, small ponytail, with short, loose face-framing wisps; the authored description calls this short auburn hair that she tucks behind one ear.
- <Picture 1> supplies only her face, glasses and hair. Its grey top and cream backdrop are not used.
- <Video 2> supplies her body proportions, bare legs and bare feet, and her transformed Elementalist costume, continuing from the previous shot. The costume has a fitted lavender bodice with silver-piped seams and an iridescent lavender-to-blue sheen. It has a sheer lavender mesh yoke with silver strap lines and a high, silver-edged stand collar with a small blue crystal at the throat. Sculpted silver hip plates meet in a V. The short, layered, ruffled lavender skirt has deep-blue under-layers. Long lavender opera-length gauntlets carry angular silver arm guards. A slim, angular silver circlet holds one faceted, diamond-shaped blue-violet crystal at her hairline.
- Long decorative lavender-and-deep-blue side panels hang from the hip plates.
- <Audio 1> (Posh Riley) is the voice of RILEY (S1). She speaks no words in this shot.
<Subject 2> is Riley's desk and desktop clutter, supplied by <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>. It has a warm honey-wood top and a black mechanical keyboard with rainbow RGB backlighting and a wrist rest. There is a black mouse pad with a mouse, and two small black speakers. A white mug sits at the left end. A matte-black gaming headset lies on the desk; it has padded cups with a glowing blue ring on each outer cup. A white-shaded table lamp stands at the right end, switched off. A few loose papers lie near the lamp.
<Subject 3> is Riley's monitor, supplied by <Picture 2>. It is a thin, black flat-panel display on a black stand at the centre of the desk. None of the desktop text shown in <Picture 2> appears; its screen becomes the portal.
<Subject 4> is Riley's dark, cluttered night-time bedroom, supplied by <Picture 3> and <Picture 2>.
- It has cream walls, beige carpet and a plain textured ceiling.
- A large, dim fantasy poster hangs above the desk and stays in shadow.
- An unmade bed with a grey headboard and rumpled white sheets stands at the far right.
- Discarded clothes lie scattered around.
- Every lamp and the ceiling light are off, and there is no ceiling dent.
<Subject 5> is Riley's racing-style gaming chair, supplied by <Video 1>. It is soft pink faux leather with white side bolsters and a tall winged backrest. The back of the backrest is a smooth pink panel with two black-rimmed cut-outs near the top. Thin iridescent purple-blue piping runs along its edges. It has black armrests and a black five-star base with pink inlays and black casters.
<Subject 6> is the sunlit Noxian alley seen through the monitor, supplied by <Picture 4>. It has pale, weathered stone-block walls, cobblestones and bright, warm daylight under a pale sky. A tall black banner with a crimson border and a pale metallic emblem hangs from the wall.
summary:
Generate a static wide shot from behind <Subject 1>, who stands in her lavender Elementalist costume in the dark bedroom. The monitor brightens into a window onto the sunlit stone alley of <Subject 6>, where a crimson-bordered banner stirs in the breeze. Warm daylight floods the night-dark room. A draft pulls her skirt and side panels toward the screen, and she plants a hand on the desk to steady herself. She ends braced, silhouetted against a blazing doorway of daylight.

- Transfer: only the alley's pale sunlit stone, cobbles, daylight and one black-and-crimson banner, seen through the screen.

This opening differs from the previous shot's low frontal floor angle: the camera is now behind Riley at standing height, facing the monitor.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 9.42 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is locked off at chest height a few paces behind <Subject 1>. It frames a static wide shot looking past her toward <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> against the far wall of <Subject 4>. The camera never moves; only light and wind change.

Riley stands just right of frame centre, seen from behind, one step from the desk. Her low ponytail and loose wisps sit beneath the thin silver band of the circlet. The silver-piped lavender bodice, silver hip plates, lavender ruffles and long side panels hang still. Her bare legs and feet rest on the beige carpet, and her gauntlets reach her elbows. At frame left, <Subject 5> stands turned away, its smooth pink back and black cut-outs facing camera. The desk spans the middle ground: the rainbow-lit keyboard, white mug, blue-ringed headset and unlit lamp. Above it, the monitor's black bezel frames a dim navy-and-lavender glow. The shadowed poster, walls and the bed at frame right sit in near darkness.

From 0 to about 1.5 seconds, Riley lowers her left hand from her ear and goes still. The screen glow swells and the hum deepens.

From about 1.5 to 3.5 seconds, the screen flares white-gold, then clears like a window opening onto <Subject 6>. Sunlit pale stone blocks and cobbles appear, and a tall black banner with a crimson border stirs in the breeze. Warm daylight pours through the bezel in a broad shaft. It washes the desk, keyboard and carpet, rims Riley's outline in gold and throws her long shadow back toward the camera. Dust motes glitter in the beam, while the bedroom's corners stay night-dark.

From about 3.5 to 6.0 seconds, a draft begins pulling toward the screen. Her hair wisps lift forward. The side panels peel away from her hips and stream toward the monitor, and the ruffles billow forward. She leans back against the pull, and her bare heels skid a few centimetres across the carpet. The loose papers by the lamp riffle.

From about 6.0 to 8.0 seconds, the pull strengthens and tips her forward. She shoots out her right arm and plants her gauntleted palm flat on the desk beside the keyboard, fingers splayed and elbow locked. The mug rattles. Her left arm swings out for balance and her shoulders set. Her head turns slightly, so a sliver of freckled cheek and the silver arm of her glasses catch the light. Her face is unchanged. She draws one sharp breath without speaking.

From about 8.0 seconds to the end, she holds the brace. In the last frame of [Shot 1], Riley stands silhouetted against the blazing rectangle of daylight, her right hand planted on the desk. Her panels and ruffles stream toward the light, and the banner ripples beyond.
overall_soundscape:
Daylight invades the night, carried on a rushing breeze. The monitor's deep hum swells, then gives way to open outdoor air. Wind rushes through the screen, and the distant banner flaps. Fabric flutters and snaps as the side panels stream forward. The hip plates give a faint metallic tink, and bare heels squeak on the carpet. Papers riffle. Her gauntleted palm lands on the wood with a firm thump, and the mug rattles. Riley draws one sharp breath. There are no words.
non_diegetic_music:
An airy, rising adventure motif. Soft sustained strings and a bright horn line swell as the daylight opens and lift steadily with the draft. The cue crests on an open, expectant chord as she braces against the light.

videos.name: Gaming chair reference
videos.description: Intended use: this reel is meant to define a modern racing-style gaming chair for later shots. It describes an intended design, not verified output. The chair is upholstered in soft pink faux leather with white accents. It has a tall winged backrest with white side bolsters, a diamond-quilted pink centre panel and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping along the backrest and seat. A white headrest pillow carries a small grey printed wordmark. Two black straps run down to a lumbar pillow with a pink centre, white side bands and a white chevron emblem. The seat is a pink bucket seat with white bolsters. The chair has black adjustable armrests with flat black pads, one with a short silver section on its post. Underneath are a black recline mechanism with a lever on one side, a black height lever, a black seat base and gas cylinder, and a black five-star base with pink inlay panels on each leg and black twin-wheel casters. The completed sides are newly designed to match the visible ones. The back of the backrest is intended as a smooth pink panel framed by white side sections and piping, with the headrest pillow straps visible. The opposite side is intended to mirror the visible armrest and bolster styling. Later shots should place the chair with their own position, scale, framing, lighting, camera motion and action. They should not inherit this reel's orbit, white backdrop or timing unless their own instructions call for it. Explicit target-shot instructions may change the chair's condition or surroundings.

videos.name: Riley reference
videos.description:
Intended coverage, not verified output: this 8-second silent square reel is planned as an identity-first neutral turntable of Riley.

The first view is intended to show her full body:
- a brief frontal hold
- one even camera orbit around her while she stays still, passing right profile, full back and left profile
- a closing frontal hold

A clean cut is then intended to show a stationary frontal face close-up.

Intended uses:
- checking facial likeness, including freckles, brows and ears
- checking the round silver wire glasses
- checking auburn-brown hair volume, the loose face-framing strands and the low ponytail
- checking natural slender proportions
- checking side and rear silhouettes
- checking continuity of the one lavender-and-silver fantasy costume: crystal tiara, mesh-yoke bodice with stand collar, hip plates, ruffled skirt, opera gloves with arm guards, and bare feet

Limits:
- There is no articulation, no expression range and no speech or voice.
- The rear and sides of the costume and hairstyle were not observed in the source photos. They are meant to be continued conservatively, so treat them as generated interpretation, not ground truth.
- The capture shows a single outfit only.

Before reuse, inspect the views actually generated. Confirm that:
- each planned angle appears
- the orbit did not warp the body or face
- proportions stay natural and unslimmed
- the glasses, tiara and costume details stay consistent without invented fastenings or markings
- the face in the close-up matches the full-body views

Discard or regenerate the reel if any of these fail.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 6.58 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is locked off at eye height beside the screen of <Subject 3>, looking straight back across the near edge of <Subject 2> at <Subject 1>. It frames a frontal medium close-up, from just below her silver hip plates to just above her circlet, with shallow depth of field. The camera never moves; only the wind, the fabric, the light and Riley change.

Riley stands at frame centre, leaning slightly back against a pull that drags toward the camera. Warm golden daylight from the portal floods her face and front. It makes the lavender bodice shimmer blue and glints along the silver piping, the collar crystal and the circlet's blue-violet crystal. Her freckles and brown eyes read clearly. Behind her, <Subject 4> falls away into night darkness. A strip of cream wall catches faint spill, and the grey headboard and white sheets blur at screen left. Beside them sits the soft pink-and-white shape of <Subject 5>, with its quilted panel and purple-blue piping. Her right arm angles down toward screen left, where her gloved palm stays planted on the desk edge in the lower-left corner, holding the brace from the previous shot. Her left arm hangs free at screen right, near the white mug at the lower-right edge.

From 0 to about 1.2 seconds, the opening composition shows Riley squinting hard into the light, her eyes narrowed behind her round glasses. The lenses hold tiny reflected rectangles of pale sunlit stone and a black banner with a crimson border. Her loose strands flutter toward the camera, and her low ponytail swings forward over her left shoulder. The side panels lift from both hips and strain toward the lens.

From about 1.2 to 3.6 seconds, she sets her jaw, lifts her chin and glares straight into the light. RILEY (S1) says <d>[English] No way I’m showing up looking like *this*.</d> She speaks with clipped, indignant firmness and lands hard stress on the final word. She gives a small, stubborn shake of the head, her brows drawn tight.

From about 3.6 to 5.0 seconds, the draft surges and the mug rattles on the wood. The front ruffles of her skirt peel up and stream toward the camera, flashing their deep-blue under-layers. Her eyes snap down. Her left hand shoots down and seizes a fistful of lavender ruffle at her hip, low at screen right, and yanks it back against the pull. Her gloved knuckles tighten on the fabric while her right palm stays planted.

From about 5.0 seconds to the end, she lifts her gaze back to the light with her chin up, looking defiant and a little absurd. In the ending composition, Riley stands frontal, her hair still tossing and her fist clenched on the lavender fabric at the lower frame edge. Her face is unchanged, lit gold.
overall_soundscape:
Wind-tossed and comically defiant. Wind rushes steadily out of the portal, and a banner flaps faintly in the distance. Fabric flutters and snaps as the side panels strain, the hip plates give a faint metallic tink, and the mug rattles on the wood. Riley delivers her line firmly over the wind in the timbre of <Audio 1>. The ruffles give a sharp rustle and snap as her fist closes on them, followed by a short, determined exhale.
non_diegetic_music:
The adventure motif returns with a stubborn beat. A brisk, heroic horn line rides over a dogged, stomping percussion pattern that digs in under her line. The cue lands on a firm, punchy accent as her fist closes on the skirt.

The camera never moves; only the wind, the fabric, the light and Riley change.

Riley stands at frame centre, leaning slightly back against a pull that drags toward the camera. Warm golden daylight from the portal floods her face and front. It makes the lavender bodice shimmer blue and glints along the silver piping, the collar crystal and the circlet's blue-violet crystal. Her freckles and brown eyes read clearly. Behind her, <Subject 4> falls away into night darkness. A strip of cream wall catches faint spill, and the grey headboard and white sheets blur at screen left. Beside them sits the soft pink-and-white shape of <Subject 5>, with its quilted panel and purple-blue piping. Her right arm angles down toward screen left, where her gloved palm stays planted on the desk edge in the lower-left corner, holding the brace from the previous shot. Her left arm hangs free at screen right, near the white mug at the lower-right edge.

The seat is a pink bucket seat with white bolsters. The chair has black adjustable armrests with flat black pads, one with a short silver section on its post. Underneath are a black recline mechanism with a lever on one side, a black height lever, a black seat base and gas cylinder, and a black five-star base with pink inlay panels on each leg and black twin-wheel casters. The completed sides are newly designed to match the visible ones. The back of the backrest is intended as a smooth pink panel framed by white side sections and piping, with the headrest pillow straps visible. The opposite side is intended to mirror the visible armrest and bolster styling. Later shots should place the chair with their own position, scale, framing, lighting, camera motion and action. Behind her, <Subject 3> lies in night darkness. The cream walls catch faint spill, the desk clutter is dim, and the soft pink-and-white shape of <Subject 5> sits in the background.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 11.54 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is locked off at chest height to the left of the desk, angled three-quarter frontal onto Riley, and it never moves. The frame leaves room above her head and below her feet, so that her whole figure fits once she steps back.

<Subject 1> stands centre-right, turned three-quarters toward screen left. At the left frame edge, the thin black bezel of <Subject 2> blazes white-gold. Inside the screen, vague pale stone and a black-and-crimson banner of <Subject 4> glow. This warm daylight is the key light and rakes across her from screen left. Behind her, <Subject 3> lies in night darkness. The cream walls catch faint spill, the desk clutter is dim, and the soft pink-and-white shape of <Subject 5> sits in the background.

From 0 to about 1.3 seconds, the opening composition shows Riley in the lavender Elementalist costume, leaning slightly toward the desk so that she reads medium-full. Her left hand is planted on the desk edge. Her right fist clutches a handful of ruffled lavender skirt while the draft tugs the fabric toward the screen. Her circlet crystal glints and her jaw is set.

At about 1.3 seconds, a pulse of golden light blooms from her fist. The lavender fabric in her grip dissolves into drifting golden motes. The dissolve races over the hip plates, bodice, mesh yoke, collar, gloves and circlet. She releases the desk and takes a half-step back to the centre of the frame.

From about 2.3 to 8 seconds, the light lifts her onto the balls of her bare feet. She spins on the spot through two smooth turns, her arms opening and her ponytail swinging out. Early in the first turn, for less than a second, she is in the plain grey strapless bra and briefs, seen mostly side-on. This glimpse is non-explicit, veiled by swirling golden sparkle and held in the wide static framing with no emphasis.

Still turning, ribbons of gold wrap her torso and snap into the royal-blue sleeveless bodice. White cloud-embroidered panels and gold trim bloom across it, and the high collar closes at her throat with its small gold clasp. Layered blue-and-white armored panels fan out into the short skirt. Light slides down each arm, forming white sleeves with blue cloud swirls, pale-blue flares and ornate cuffs. Glossy blue thigh-high boots climb from her bare feet, with white stripes and gold top bands. A white-and-gold ornament sparkles into her hair above the unchanged ponytail.

From about 8 to 11.54 seconds, she slows out of the spin and settles onto the boot heels, which touch the floor. She now stands full-length, three-quarter to camera. Her arms ease to her sides, and her face, glasses and hair are unchanged. Bright royal blues glow as the gold fades into steady portal daylight, and the draft stirs her skirt panels toward the screen. In the ending composition, Riley stands full-length in the royal-blue outfit as the light settles, and her eyes just begin to drop toward herself.
overall_soundscape:
Pulse of golden light; bright royal blues. A low electrical hum comes from the monitor beneath a steady rush of portal wind. A deep, resonant whoomp marks the golden pulse, and a crystalline shimmer hisses as the fabric dissolves. An airy, rising whoosh carries through the spin. Soft fabric snaps and bright metallic ticks follow as the bodice, armored panels, cuffs and boots form. Two boot heels click on the floor. Riley's only sound is a small, quick intake of breath as she is lifted, in the timbre of <Audio 1>. When the light settles, only the wind and the hum remain.
non_diegetic_music:
A shorter sparkle transformation cue plays: rising harp glissandi, glittering chimes and a shimmering synth swell under the spin. It resolves in a quick, bright flourish as the boots land, then decays as the light settles.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 5.17 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is locked off below Riley's chest height and tilted up at her face in a low-angle close-up. It never moves. Her head and shoulders fill the frame, from the ornament on top of her hair down to the gold-edged top of her bodice.

<Subject 1> sits just right of centre, leaving air at screen left toward the unseen <Subject 2>. Warm white-gold portal daylight comes from off-frame screen left. It rakes across her cheek, her glasses and the gold trim, while the right side of her face falls into cool shadow. Behind her, the upper wall and plain cream ceiling of <Subject 3> sit in night darkness, catching only faint warm spill. At the lower right corner, the soft, out-of-focus top of the pink-and-white winged backrest of <Subject 5> glows faintly along its iridescent edge.

From 0 to about 1.3 seconds, the opening composition shows Riley with her head tilted down, chin tucked and eyes lowered toward her own body. Because the camera is below her, her downturned face stays readable: her brows are raised and her lips slightly parted as she inspects herself. Her pale blue-white gloved hand, with its flared light-blue cuff, rises into the lower frame edge and pinches the white cloud-swirl panel below her collar, flicking it once. The blue, white and gold ornament in her hair catches the light.

From about 1.3 to 2 seconds, her expression sours. Her mouth flattens, her nose wrinkles and her brows knit, and her hand drops out of frame.

At about 2 seconds, she snaps her head up and turns her face toward screen left, and her eyes lock onto the monitor above the lens line. Her ponytail and loose wisps swing with the movement. A tiny bright rectangle appears in each lens, holding faint pale stone and a black-and-crimson banner shape from <Subject 4>.

From about 2.2 to 4.6 seconds, with her chin raised and jaw jutting, she protests up at the screen. RILEY (S1) says <d>[English] I said armor, not porcelain! Metal!</d> She leans slightly forward through the first sentence, and her brows flare at the complaint. She bites off the final single word with one sharp, emphatic nod.

From about 4.6 seconds to the end, the ending composition shows Riley's face angled up toward screen left. She looks indignant: her lips are pressed tight, her nostrils flare, and her eyes are wide behind her glasses, which glint with portal light. Her collar and hair ornament are bright against the dark ceiling, and the frame holds still.
overall_soundscape:
Exasperated comedy, dry and close. A low electrical hum comes from the monitor, with a steady soft rush of portal wind. A light fabric rustle and a faint stiff tick sound as she flicks the bodice panel, followed by a short disgruntled exhale as her face sours. Her voice is close and dry in the small, dark room. Hum and wind continue under the final indignant hold.
non_diegetic_music:
A comic sting. A short, sharp comedic hit lands immediately after her final word: a muted-trumpet wah-wah over a pizzicato-and-snare stab. It decays quickly into the room hum. There is no other music.

[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 11.54 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is locked off at chest height, frontal to Riley, in a full shot from above her hair to the carpet under her feet. It never moves.

<Subject 1> stands centred, facing the lens. Behind her in <Subject 3>, the unmade bed, the night-black window and the cluttered nightstand sit in darkness. The pink-and-white backrest of <Subject 5> glows faintly at the lower left edge, beside a sliver of dark desk. Warm golden daylight from the off-frame <Subject 2> rakes across her from screen left, and her right side falls into cool shadow.

From 0 to 1 second, the opening composition shows Riley in the royal-blue Classic outfit, thigh-high heeled boots and hair ornament. Her fists are at her sides, her jaw is set, and her eyes are turned toward screen left.

At about 1 second, the light pulses again, flaring white-gold. Ribbons of light spiral up from the carpet around her. She rises onto the balls of her feet, flings her arms out and begins a fast, graceful magical-girl spin on the spot. Her ponytail whips outward.

From about 1.6 to 2.6 seconds, as she spins, the blue fabric, gloves, heeled boots and ornament unravel into streaming blue and gold sparkles from the collar downward. For one split-second rotation she is barefoot in her plain grey strapless bra and briefs, softened by motion blur and dense glowing particles. It is playful and non-lingering, and the framing stays wide.

From about 2.6 to 3.8 seconds, still turning, the dark-navy bodysuit sweeps up from her ankles to her throat like poured ink. It seals at the high neck with a taut snap.

From about 3.8 to 9.4 seconds, she keeps spinning, now slower, and each armor piece locks on with a crisp flash:
- The silver breastplate and broad collar clamp onto her chest as she passes face-front, and the red gem glints.
- The ivory mantle drops onto her shoulders and flares outward with the turn, its gold embroidery catching the light across her back.
- The belt, gold buckle, silver hip plates and ivory panels cinch at her waist, and she exhales at the tug.
- She snaps both forearms out as the silver gauntlets close over them, their white ruffled cuffs spilling out.
- The angular knee plates lock over her shins.
- The dark-brown boots form up her calves. She finishes the spin facing the lens and plants each heel with a solid stomp, noticeably lower now that the heels are gone.

From about 9.4 seconds to the end, the sparkles settle and the light returns to steady portal glow. Riley lowers her arms, rolls her shoulders under the new weight and glances down at the silver breastplate with a small, satisfied lift of her brows. The ending composition shows her standing full-length and still in navy-and-silver armor, facing the lens with her hands loose at her sides. Her glasses and ponytail are unchanged.
overall_soundscape:
Satisfying, mechanical, solid. A low electrical hum comes from the monitor under a soft rush of portal air. A rising shimmering whoosh accompanies the pulse and the spin, with a sparkling fizz as the blue fabric unravels. The bodysuit seals with a smooth, taut zip-snap. Crisp metallic CLICKS and clamps follow in order: a deep clank for the breastplate, a cloth flutter for the mantle, a leather cinch and buckle click, two sharp gauntlet snaps and knee-plate clicks. Two solid boot stomps land on the carpet. Riley's breaths are soft, with one small exhale at the belt. The sparkle decays into the room hum.
non_diegetic_music:
A heroic brass-tinged transformation cue swells with the light pulse, over rising strings and a building timpani roll through the spin. Brass stabs accent the key armor clicks. It lands on a bold, resolved brass chord as she plants her boots, then decays under the room hum.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 5.17 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is locked off at the monitor's position, at desk height, looking straight back into the room. It never moves.

Opening composition, from 0 to 0.6 seconds:
- Center frame: <Subject 1>'s strained face fills the middle of the frame, close and frontal, with her glasses catching hard golden reflections.
- Lower third: both bare hands clamp white-knuckled over the front edge of <Subject 2>. Her silver gauntlets and white ruffled cuffs gleam, with her forearms locked straight.
- Lower foreground: the RGB keyboard glows out of focus.
- Her pose: her silver collar, red gem and ivory mantle show below her chin. Her body angles up and back out of the top of the frame toward the ceiling.
- Her hair: her ponytail and wisps whip straight toward the lens.
- Lighting: warm golden daylight from behind the camera blasts her face and armor. Behind her, <Subject 3> sinks into cool darkness, with the faint window rectangle, the rumpled bed and the soft pink shape of <Subject 5>. Loose mail streams past toward camera.

From about 0.6 to 1.8 seconds, she grits her teeth, then lifts her chin and shouts past the lens at the portal with indignant urgency. RILEY (S1) says <d>[English] Careful, I rent—</d>

The line breaks off at about 1.8 seconds. Her fingertips skid across the wood. Her eyes widen behind her glasses and her mouth stays open mid-word.

At about 2.0 seconds, her right hand tears free, then her left. The suction snatches her forward.

From about 2.1 to 3.0 seconds, she rushes straight toward the lens. Her face and breastplate swell to fill the frame, and her mantle and hair flare around her. She blurs past the camera's left edge and exits frame. The desk edge is left bare, and papers and a cable whip after her.

From about 3.0 to 3.8 seconds, the golden light surges and blooms across the empty desk and the dark room.

The ending composition, from about 3.8 seconds to the end, is the whole frame flared to bright, even daylight white.

overall_soundscape:
Frantic and blinding.
- A roaring, whistling portal vortex howls throughout.
- Papers flutter and snap, and a cable rattles on wood.
- Her armor plates clank and creak under strain.
- Her fingers squeak and skid on the desk edge before a sharp release.
- Her shout is cut off into a short startled gasp as she is yanked.
- A rushing air blast passes the lens, then all diegetic sound drops away into silence with the white flare.

non_diegetic_music:
Whoosh into silence. A rising, whooshing wind swell builds under her grip and peaks as she flies past the lens. It then cuts to complete silence on the white-out.

She clings to the edge of <Subject 2>, her hair whipping toward the lens, and starts to shout a line. Her fingers slip and the suction hurls her toward and past the camera. The frame then flares to bright daylight white.

retention_analysis:
This shot opens differently from the previous shot, which was a wide, side-on, floor-to-ceiling profile. This shot opens close and frontal, from the monitor's point of view, on her face and hands.
<Picture 1>
- Keep: her exact face, freckles, brown eyes, brows, lips, round silver glasses, and low auburn ponytail with wisps. At this close size they must read clearly.
- Do not use: the grey top, the cream backdrop or the calm portrait expression and lighting.
<Video 2>
- Keep: the outfit pieces, colours and materials above, especially the silver gauntlets, white ruffled cuffs, bare hands, collar with red gem, breastplate and ivory mantle.
- Do not copy: the neutral stance, the studio backdrop, the orbit or the source framing.
<Picture 2> and <Picture 5>
- Keep: the wooden desk surface, the RGB keyboard glow, the mouse pad, mouse and cables.
- Change: they are seen from behind the monitor, low in the foreground and soft. The lamp is off and the screen UI is not seen.
<Picture 3>
- Keep: the dark room layout behind her, including the bed, the window, the clutter and the mail-covered side table.
- Change: the room is unlit apart from the portal glare. The posters are behind the camera, and a shallow ceiling dent persists from the previous shot.
<Picture 4>
- Transfer: the warm golden daylight colour only.
- Do not copy: the crates, barrels, banners or composition.
<Video 1>
- Keep: the chair's pink-and-white styling as a soft background shape.
- Do not copy: the white backdrop, the orbit or the headrest wordmark.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 5.17 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is locked off at the monitor's position, at desk height, looking straight back into the room. It never moves.

Opening composition, from 0 to 0.6 seconds:
- Center frame: <Subject 1>'s strained face fills the middle of the frame, close and frontal, with her glasses catching hard golden reflections.
- Lower third: both bare hands clamp white-knuckled over the front edge of <Subject 2>. Her silver gauntlets and white ruffled cuffs gleam, with her forearms locked straight.
- Lower foreground: the RGB keyboard glows out of focus.
- Her pose: her silver collar, red gem and ivory mantle show below her chin. Her body angles up and back out of the top of the frame toward the ceiling.
- Her hair: her ponytail and wisps whip straight toward the lens.
- Lighting: warm golden daylight from behind the camera blasts her face and armor. Behind her, <Subject 3> sinks into cool darkness, with the faint window rectangle, the rumpled bed and the soft pink shape of <Subject 5>. Loose mail streams past toward camera.

From about 0.6 to 1.8 seconds, she grits her teeth, then lifts her chin and shouts past the lens at the portal with indignant urgency. RILEY (S1) says <d>[English] Careful, I rent—</d>

The line breaks off at about 1.8 seconds. Her fingertips skid across the wood. Her eyes widen behind her glasses and her mouth stays open mid-word.

At about 2.0 seconds, her right hand tears free, then her left. The suction snatches her forward.

From about 2.1 to 3.0 seconds, she rushes straight toward the lens. Her face and breastplate swell to fill the frame, and her mantle and hair flare around her. She blurs past the camera's left edge and exits frame. The desk edge is left bare, and papers and a cable whip after her.

From about 3.0 to 3.8 seconds, the golden light surges and blooms across the empty desk and the dark room.

The ending composition, from about 3.8 seconds to the end, is the whole frame flared to bright, even daylight white.

overall_soundscape:
Frantic and blinding.
- A roaring, whistling portal vortex howls throughout.
- Papers flutter and snap, and a cable rattles on wood.
- Her armor plates clank and creak under strain.
- Her fingers squeak and skid on the desk edge before a sharp release.
- Her shout is cut off into a short startled gasp as she is yanked.
- A rushing air blast passes the lens, then all diegetic sound drops away into silence with the white flare.

non_diegetic_music:
Whoosh into silence. A rising, whooshing wind swell builds under her grip and peaks as she flies past the lens. It then cuts to complete silence on the white-out.

shotContent.prompt:
subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is Riley, a soft-featured, pretty 24-year-old woman with a slim natural build. <Picture 1> supplies her facial identity only: fair skin with faint freckles, warm brown eyes, straight brows, full soft lips, auburn-brown hair parted slightly off-center with loose face-framing strands, tied back in a low ponytail, and round thin silver wire-frame glasses. Its grey knit top and plain backdrop are not imported. <Video 1> supplies her body proportions, hair silhouette from every side and her canonical navy-and-silver armor. The armor consists of a fitted navy high-neck bodysuit, a polished silver breastplate with gold edging, silver gorget pieces, and a cream capelet trimmed in gold with a red jewel brooch at the left shoulder. Below that are silver vambraces over white ruffled cuffs, a brown leather belt with a gold buckle, cream gold-trimmed tassets at the hips, silver knee guards, and dark brown knee-high boots with gold trim and swirl emblems. <Audio 1> (Posh Riley) supplies Riley's voice timbre for non-verbal effort sounds only. <Subject 2> is the Noxian alley, defined by <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>. It has pale grey stone-block walls, worn cobblestones with tufts of grass, tall black banners bordered in crimson with pale horned Noxian crests, an iron wall lantern, and banded wooden barrels. Dark Gothic facades with arched doors line the far side, and a tall spired tower rises in the hazy distance. <Subject 3> is a set of empty brown plank crates with X-braced sides and dark iron corner brackets, as seen in <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>. <Subject 4> is a glowing magical rift hanging in mid-air.
summary: Generate a single static slapstick shot from reference images. Riley, in her navy-and-silver armor, drops out of a collapsing rift into a stack of empty crates in a sunlit Noxian alley, and one last crate ends up covering her head.
retention_analysis: Keep Riley's face, freckles, glasses, hair color and ponytail from <Picture 1> and <Video 1>. Keep the full armor from <Video 1> exactly, with no added props, markings or weapons. Do not copy her neutral standing pose, the turntable orbit or the studio backdrop. Keep the alley's architecture, materials, banners, lantern, barrel placement and daylight from <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>. <Picture 2> guides the down-alley eye-level layout, with the crates along the left wall and the barrels at the right. The crates may be re-stacked into a pile of two or three levels. <Subject 4> is new to this shot. No first or last frame image is assigned.
detailed_description: [Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 6.583333333333333 seconds, framed 16:9. The camera is locked off at eye level for a static wide shot looking down the length of <Subject 2>, with no camera movement throughout. Pale stone walls with black-and-crimson banners and the iron lantern run along the left of frame. Cobblestones recede toward the hazy spired tower at the center. Wooden barrels sit at the right edge. Broad daylight rakes across the cobbles, leaving the base of the left wall in cool shadow. Left of center, <Subject 3> is stacked against the wall: three crates on the bottom row, two on the next row and one on top. Hanging in mid-air about head height above the pile, <Subject 4> glows as a crackling oval of white-gold and violet light that throws a flickering sheen onto the stone. In the opening second the rift shudders and begins to shrink inward. <Subject 1> tumbles out of it shoulders-first with her arms flailing, cream capelet flapping and boots kicking. She lets out a short startled yelp in her own voice, without words. She crashes back-first into the top of the stack. Planks crack, the top crates burst sideways and skid across the cobbles, and dust and splinters puff into the sunlight. Behind her, the rift pinches down to a bright point and winks out. Riley ends sprawled across the flattened lower crates. Her legs hang over one crate edge with the boots in the air, her arms are thrown wide, her glasses sit crooked and her ponytail is splayed. She blinks, dazed, and lets out a small winded groan. A single crate that was knocked loose teeters on the wall-side remains of the stack. It tips, flips once, and drops open-side down squarely over her head and shoulders with a hollow thunk. Her face disappears inside it. Her arms flop onto the cobbles and one boot gives a small twitch. In the final beat the dust settles in the sunbeams. The alley is quiet and still, and the lantern and banners are unchanged. The ending composition holds on the static wide: Riley sprawled in the wrecked crates in full navy-and-silver armor, one crate covering her head, with the empty sunlit alley behind her.
overall_soundscape: Bright daylight ambience fills the stone alley with faint distant city murmur. The rift gives a rising magical crackle, then a sharp collapsing whoomp and a small pop as it closes. Wood clatters loudly and splinters crack as Riley lands, followed by crates skidding and scraping on the cobbles and armor plates clanking. Riley makes a short wordless yelp and a winded groan. The final crate lands with a hollow wooden thunk. Stray splinters settle in the quiet that follows. There is no dialogue.
non_diegetic_music: A brief clattering comic stinger in a slapstick percussion hit style lands with the final crate over Riley's head.

Intended coverage (not verified output): This 8-second silent, identity-first neutral turntable is planned to capture Riley's facial likeness, natural body proportions, side and rear silhouettes, hair volume and continuity of one canonical outfit.
- Planned views: a frontal full-body hold, one complete even camera orbit around the stationary figure, and a final frontal full-body hold. These should cover the front, three-quarter views, both profiles and the full back.
- The orbit is intended to show the ponytail placement, the capelet over the upper back and the boot and armor silhouettes from every side.
- After a clean cut, a stationary frontal face close-up is intended to show facial geometry, freckles, the face-framing strands and the round silver wire-frame glasses.

Limits:
- There is no speech, expression change or body articulation. The reel is not suited to lip-sync, voice, gesture or performance reference.
- The rear and side details of the outfit and hair are conservative continuations, not observed from the source photos. Treat them as provisional.
- The face comes from a different photo than the outfit. Confirm that the face and outfit read as one consistent person.

Before reuse, inspect the views actually generated:
- The face matches the intended likeness and the glasses stay on in every view.
- The body proportions are unaltered.
- The outfit stays identical throughout, including the brooch position, trims and armor pieces.
- The orbit is complete and smooth, with no drift or morphing.
- No invented markings, fastenings or accessories appear.

shotContent.prompt:
subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is Riley, a soft-featured, pretty 24-year-old woman with a slim, natural build.
- Face, from <Picture 1>: fair skin with faint freckles, warm brown eyes, straight dark brows, a straight nose and full soft lips. She wears round, thin silver wire-frame glasses.
- Hair, from <Picture 1>: auburn-brown, parted slightly off-centre, with loose face-framing strands beside her cheeks. The rest is drawn back into a low ponytail.
- The grey knit top and plain backdrop of <Picture 1> are not imported.
- The inspected preview stills of <Video 1> confirm the same face, freckles and glasses in a frontal close-up. They also show her ponytail and silhouette from the front, both three-quarter views, both profiles and the back.
- Armor, from <Video 1>: her canonical navy-and-silver armor. It has a fitted navy high-neck bodysuit, a polished silver breastplate with gold edging, and a silver gorget and shoulder plates. A cream capelet with gold scroll embroidery and gold trim sits over the shoulders, with a red jewel brooch at her right shoulder. She has silver vambraces over white ruffled cuffs, a brown leather belt with a gold buckle, cream gold-trimmed tassets over silver hip plates, silver knee guards, and dark knee-high boots with gold scroll trim.
- <Picture 6> confirms this same armor, face, glasses and ponytail on Riley as she sits on a crate in the alley.
- <Audio 1> (Posh Riley) is Riley (S1)'s voice and supplies only her voice timbre.

<Subject 2> is the Noxian alley, defined by <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, <Picture 4> and <Picture 6>. It has walls of large pale grey stone blocks. Long black banners hang on them, with frayed crimson borders, pointed hems with a crimson diamond motif, and pale horned Noxian crests with red insets. The ground is worn grey cobblestones with grass tufts in the joints. The alley also has banded wooden barrels, a black iron wall lantern, and dark Gothic facades with arched doors.

<Subject 3> is the pile of empty brown plank crates at the foot of the stone wall. They have X-braced sides and dark iron corner brackets, and loose broken planks lie scattered on the cobbles around them. The crate design comes from <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>, and their arrangement around Riley comes from <Picture 6>.

<Subject 4> is Riley's staff, defined by <Picture 5> and placed by <Picture 6>.
- Head: three swept, flame-like gold prongs cradling a softly glowing pearly-white orb, above an ornate wrapped gold collar.
- Shaft: long and straight, wrapped in black scale-textured leather, with a gold ring partway down and a long gold sleeve below.
- Lower end: a gold ferrule with an openwork diamond knot and a pointed gold spike.
summary: Generate a single static, reference-driven high-angle shot looking steeply down on Riley as she sits among the crates in the sunlit Noxian alley, with her staff lying on the cobbles beside her. She looks down at her armor, then at the staff. She tries a small swiping spell gesture in the air, and nothing happens. She asks her one-word question hopefully. The shot ends with her hand still raised mid-gesture, in a tone of deflated comedy.
retention_analysis: Preserve the following:
- Riley's exact face, freckles, brown eyes, brows, lips and round silver wire-frame glasses, from <Picture 1> and the face close-up of <Video 1>.
- Her auburn hair colour, face-framing strands and low ponytail, from the same sources.
- Her full armor exactly as shown in <Video 1> and confirmed by <Picture 6>. Seen from above, the capelet over both shoulders, the gorget, breastplate, red brooch, vambraces and knee guards read clearly. No new markings or accessories are added.
- The staff's gold flame prongs, pearly orb, black scaled shaft, gold rings and spiked diamond-knot ferrule, from <Picture 5>.
- From <Picture 6>: Riley seated on a central crate with stacked crates on both sides, and broken planks on the cobbles. The staff lies flat on the cobbles at frame right, head near her left boot and shaft running off toward a barrel.
- The pale stone blocks, banner hems, cobbles with grass, barrels and warm daylight, from <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>.

Do not copy:
- the studio backdrop, standing turntable poses, orbit or padded canvas of <Video 1>;
- the grey top of <Picture 1>;
- the grey studio backdrop and upright presentation of <Picture 5>;
- the motion blur and dim exposure of <Picture 4>;
- the eye-level frontal framing of <Picture 6>, which becomes a high angle here.

The author's guidance calls Riley's hair short, but every supplied image shows a low ponytail, so the ponytail is kept. The spear from the previous shot is not referenced and stays out of frame. The high-angle framing deliberately differs from the previous eye-level side profile. No first or last frame image is assigned.
detailed_description: [Shot 1] is one continuous take, generated at 7.291666666666667 seconds and framed 16:9. The camera is locked off high above and slightly in front of Riley. It looks steeply down at about sixty degrees and never moves. This is a clear break from the previous eye-level side profile: a top-down medium-wide view, with the cobbles as the floor of the frame.

<Subject 1> sits slightly left of centre on a low crate of <Subject 3>. Stacked X-braced crates with iron brackets flank her on both sides. The base of the pale stone wall of <Subject 2> runs along the top edge of frame, and the crimson-edged pointed hem of a black banner just dips in. Broken planks lie scattered across the worn grey cobbles, with grass tufts in the joints. A banded barrel edges in at the right frame border.

Warm, broad daylight falls from upper frame left. It casts a soft wall shadow across the upper cobbles and glints on her glasses, gorget and gold-edged silver breastplate. From above, her cream gold-embroidered capelet spreads over both shoulders, and the red brooch sparks at her right shoulder. Her auburn ponytail rests behind her neck, with loose strands mussed around her face. Her navy legs and silver knee guards angle forward, and her dark boots point toward lower frame.

<Subject 4> lies flat on the cobbles at frame right, beside her left boot. Its gold flame prongs and faintly glowing pearly orb sit nearest her feet. Its black scaled shaft and spiked gold ferrule run diagonally away toward the barrel.

The action unfolds in order:
1. In the opening frame, Riley sits still, hands resting on her thighs, face tilted slightly up and readable through her glasses. She looks a little dazed.
2. She tips her chin down and looks at her own armor. She taps the breastplate once with two fingers, and her brows rise at the unfamiliar silver plate.
3. Her gaze slides sideways to the staff on the cobbles. She studies it for a beat and purses her lips, considering.
4. Tentatively, she lifts her right hand to shoulder height and makes one small, neat swiping gesture through the air, like a spell. Nothing happens. The orb's faint glow does not change, and no light appears.
5. She leaves her hand hovering where the swipe ended and glances upward. Her eyebrows lift into a small, hopeful, slightly sheepish expression. Riley (S1) says <d>[English] Escape?</d> She speaks softly, with a faint rising lilt, her lips clearly shaping the word.

In the ending composition, the frame is unchanged. Riley is still seen from above among the crates, with the staff lying beside her left boot. Her right hand is still raised mid-gesture, her face is turned hopefully upward, and the orb glows faint and unimpressed.
overall_soundscape: Deflated comedy. A quiet, open daylight ambience fills the stone alley, with soft wind between the walls and a faint banner flutter above. Riley's armor gives small clinks as she shifts, and her fingertips tick once against the breastplate. Her ruffled cuff makes a tiny whisper of fabric during the swipe, followed by an awkward stillness. Her hopeful line is spoken close and soft in her own voice from <Audio 1>, followed by near-silence.
non_diegetic_music: A tiny failed-spell blip. A single small, deflating musical blip, like a short descending plink that fizzles out, lands right after her swipe produces nothing. There is no other music.

Her auburn-brown hair is parted slightly off-centre, with loose face-framing strands, and drawn back into a low ponytail. The grey knit top and plain backdrop of <Picture 1> are not imported.

<Subject 2> is the Guard (Noxian Guard), a lean, armored sentry whose face is never seen, defined by <Video 2>. He has:
- a closed, angular steel helmet with a vertical-slit faceplate, worn under a deep red hood;
- a thick black fur mantle, segmented steel pauldrons and a plain steel breastplate;
- a red tunic and a red waist sash, a dark belt with a steel buckle, and a segmented dark leather skirt;
- dark segmented bracers, dark wrapped leggings banded in red, and dark boots with steel toe caps;
- a long dark cape with a red border along its edge and hem;
- a long dark-shafted spear with a leaf-shaped steel head and a cord-wrapped grip below it, held in his right hand.

<Subject 3> is the Noxian alley, defined by <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, <Picture 4> and <Picture 7>. It has pale grey stone-block walls hung with black banners with frayed crimson borders and horned Noxian crests, an iron wall lantern, worn grey cobbles with grass tufts in the joints, banded wooden barrels, arched dark doorways and Gothic facades under a pale sky.
- <Picture 2> supplies the overall alley layout and depth.
- <Picture 3> supplies the frontal view of the banner wall with crates at its foot.
- <Picture 4> supplies the barrels and the arched doorways along the far side.

<Subject 4> is the pile of brown plank crates with X-braced sides and dark iron corner brackets, with broken planks on the cobbles. The crate design comes from <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>; their tumbled arrangement around Riley comes from <Picture 7>.

<Subject 5> is Riley's staff, defined by <Picture 5>:
- three swept, flame-like gold prongs cradling a softly glowing pearly-white orb, above an ornate gold collar;
- a black scale-textured leather shaft with a gold ring partway down;
- a gold lower ferrule with an openwork diamond knot and a pointed gold spike.

<Subject 6> is the Guard's enormous clipboard, defined by <Picture 6>:
- a heavy board of red-painted wood framed in dark riveted iron, with studded iron corner plates;
- a spiked iron clip bearing a three-pronged Noxian crest, holding a thick stack of blank, aged parchment;
- on the reverse, a pale painted crest, leather straps with iron buckles and a wrapped leather hanging bar, by which it hangs from his belt at his left hip.

His huge clipboard hangs in the near foreground, and Riley sits ahead of him among the tumbled crates. The Guard steps into her path and levels his spear at her. Riley picks up her staff and draws her elbows in, holding it close. The shot ends with her clutching the staff and facing the spearpoint. The tone is a tense standoff that is absurdly bureaucratic.

- the motion blur and dim exposure of <Picture 4>.

No first or last frame image is assigned.

detailed_description: [Shot 1] is one continuous take, generated at 6.583333333333333 seconds and framed 16:9. The camera is locked off at roughly hip height, just behind and beside the Guard's left hip, and it never moves.

The near left third of frame is filled by <Subject 2>'s left flank, slightly soft:
- the red-bordered edge of his dark cape and his segmented leather skirt;
- at his hip, the enormous <Subject 6>, hanging by its straps from his belt. Its iron-framed red board and the blank parchment under the crested clip are angled toward us, and it reaches nearly to his knee.

His steel pauldron, black fur mantle and the edge of his red hood frame the top left corner. His right hand is out of view.

In sharp focus in the mid-ground, slightly right of centre, <Subject 1> sits on the worn grey cobbles among the X-braced crates of <Subject 4>, facing toward camera. Behind her, the pale stone wall of <Subject 3> faces camera, hung with black-and-crimson crested banners. Broken planks lie scattered around her, and a banded barrel edges in at frame right. <Subject 5> lies flat on the cobbles beside her left side, toward screen right, its pearly orb glowing faintly. Warm, broad daylight falls from upper left. It throws a diagonal wall shadow across the cobbles and catches her glasses, gold-edged breastplate and cream capelet.

The action unfolds in order:
1. At the opening, the Guard is mid-stride into her path. His left boot lands with a scrape in the lower left corner, his cape swings and settles, and the heavy clipboard knocks against his thigh and sways.
2. In the same motion, the long spear swings forward from beyond his right side. It drops level across the centre of frame and stops, its leaf-shaped steel head hanging an arm's length from Riley's chest and glinting in the sun.
3. Riley goes rigid. Her eyes lock onto the spearpoint, then lift to the faceless helmet above it. Her brows shoot up behind her glasses, and her lips press together.
4. Without taking her eyes off the spear, her left hand gropes sideways along the cobbles, finds the black shaft of the staff and drags it up.
5. She pulls the staff upright against her body and grips it with both hands at her chest. She draws her elbows tight to her ribs and her knees up slightly, as if trying to take up less space. A small, shaky breath escapes her.

shotContent.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Riley (RILEY), age 24. She has no dialogue in this shot.
- <Picture 1> supplies her face: soft, pretty and lightly freckled, with brown eyes, straight dark brows, round thin silver wire-frame glasses and auburn hair with loose face-framing strands.
- <Video 2> confirms the same face and glasses. It also supplies her dark mage outfit:
  - a brown leather hooded capelet fastened at the throat;
  - a fitted, sleeveless deep-violet bodice;
  - a diagonal bandolier of corked vials with glowing blue contents;
  - a wide brown leather belt with pouches;
  - brown leather upper-arm bands and wrist bracers;
  - charcoal trousers and buckled brown knee boots.
  <Video 2> shows the hood lowered. In this shot the hood is worn up.
- <Picture 9> fixes her state at the cut. The hood is up over her hair and her glasses are on. Both hands clutch the capped staff upright against her chest. Her back is to the dark stone wall and she wears a pleased smile.
- <Picture 8> supplies her bare hand gripping the staff, her dark wrist cuff and the capelet edge.
- <Picture 6> confirms only her face and glasses in this city's daylight. Its silver armor and golden staff are obsolete here.
<Subject 2> is Riley's staff in its hooded-look form: a knotted, twisting dark-wood shaft topped by a purple crystal.
- <Picture 8> supplies this form.
- <Picture 9> shows how she holds it.
- The crystal stays dim.
<Subject 3> is the tiny iron anti-magic cap: a crown-like cage of dark forged iron with deep-red inlays, curved prongs and one tall red-edged central spike.
- <Picture 7> defines its shape.
- <Picture 8> and <Picture 9> show it seated over the crystal.
- It stays on throughout.
<Subject 4> is the narrow, shadowed side alley.
- <Picture 4> supplies tall dark-grey stone walls, arched recessed wooden doors with iron grilles, iron-banded barrels, damp cobbles and a wedge of sunlight on the ground.
- <Picture 9> fixes its lighting and dressing at the cut: deep cool shade, a large-block dark stone wall and a row of iron-banded barrels running along it.
- <Picture 2> supplies the matching barrel style, the cobbles and grass at the paving edges.
<Subject 5> is the sunlit main Noxian lane beyond the alley mouth.
- <Picture 2> supplies its overall look: pale grey stone blocks, black banners with crimson borders and pale emblems, X-braced iron-cornered crates, a wall lantern and warm daylight.
- <Picture 3> supplies the close stone, banner and crate textures.
- <Picture 9> shows how the lane reads through the mouth: a pale wall, banner edges and a crate corner.
- <Picture 6> confirms the same wall, crates and banners at ground level.
<Subject 6> is the Second Guard (SECOND GUARD), a second Noxian soldier who has no dialogue in this shot. He wears the standard uniform shown by <Video 1>:
- a red cloth hood under a closed steel helmet with a vertical slotted faceplate;
- a black fur mantle;
- a steel breastplate and layered steel pauldrons;
- a red tunic and sash, and dark leather bracers;
- a black cape with red trim;
- wrapped dark leggings and boots;
- a long dark spear with a wrapped grip.
His face is never visible. <Picture 6> confirms the black red-trimmed cape and the dark spear shaft in this street's light. He carries no clipboard.

summary:
Generate one static, reference-driven wider shot from the deep end of the barrel row in <Subject 4>, looking back along the barrels toward the bright mouth of <Subject 5>.
- The blunt butt end of <Subject 6>'s spear taps the elbow of <Subject 1>.
- She turns toward him and her pleased smile drains away.
- The take ends with her frozen, staring at the Second Guard.

retention_analysis:
Preserve:
- Riley's face, freckles, brown eyes, round silver glasses and auburn strands, from <Picture 1>, <Video 2> and <Picture 6>.
- Her hooded dark mage outfit, from <Video 2>, with the hood up as in <Picture 9>.
- Her grip and wrist cuff, from <Picture 8>.
- The knotted staff with its dim purple crystal, from <Picture 8>.
- The iron cap, from <Picture 7>, <Picture 8> and <Picture 9>.
- The shaded alley stone, barrels and cobbles, from <Picture 4>, <Picture 9> and <Picture 2>.
- The bright lane's look, from <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, <Picture 9> and <Picture 6>.
- The Second Guard's helmet, hood, fur mantle, armor, cape and spear, from <Video 1> and <Picture 6>.

Continuity:
<Picture 9> is the previous shot's last frame. It keeps Riley's hood-up wardrobe, her two-handed hold on the capped staff, her place against the wall behind the barrels, her smile and the alley's cool shade and bright mouth consistent across the cut. Its close side-on framing is not reused. This shot opens on a new reverse angle from the far end of the barrels, with the spear butt in the foreground.

Off-screen context:
<Picture 5> shows the first guard's oversized red, iron-framed clipboard. That guard is off-screen, so the clipboard does not appear, and the Second Guard does not carry it.

Allowed to change:
- The camera position and framing.
- Riley's head turn and expression.
- The Second Guard's partial, foreground presence.

Do not copy:
- the turntable poses, orbit and studio backdrops of <Video 1> and <Video 2>;
- the studio backgrounds of <Picture 1> and <Picture 5>;
- the golden staff, diagram panels, arrows and lettering of <Picture 7>;
- the armor, seated pose and foreground guard composition of <Picture 6>;
- the motion blur of <Picture 4>.

No first frame or last frame image is assigned.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take, generated at 5.17 seconds and framed 16:9. A locked-off camera stands at shoulder height at the far, deep end of the barrel row in <Subject 4>. It looks back along the barrels toward the alley mouth and never pans, tilts, dollies or zooms.

Framing, setting and lighting:
- The dark-grey block wall runs down frame right and recedes toward the mouth.
- A row of iron-banded barrels runs down frame left, from the near foreground to the mid-ground. A narrow channel of damp cobbles lies between the barrels and the wall.
- At the end of the channel, in the background, the mouth glows with <Subject 5>: pale sunlit stone, the hanging edge of a black crimson-bordered banner and a crate corner.
- The alley itself sits in cool, deep shade. Warm daylight from the mouth rims Riley's hood, glasses and the blue vials.
- In the left foreground stands <Subject 6> at this end of the barrels, partly cut by the frame edge and seen from behind his right shoulder. His black fur mantle, red hood, the curve of his steel helmet and his black red-trimmed cape are visible.
- His gloved hands hold the dark spear reversed and low, its tip rising out of frame behind him. The blunt butt end reaches diagonally across the foreground.

Opening, 0 to 1.2 seconds:
- <Subject 1> stands in the mid-ground, frame right of center, back flat to the wall and turned three-quarters away from camera toward the bright mouth.
- Her hood is up. Both hands clutch <Subject 2> upright against her chest, with <Subject 3> dark over the crystal beside her cheek.
- She is still smiling, pleased with herself, lips softly parted.
- The spear butt rests just behind her right elbow and gives it one small, deliberate tap.

Action, in order:
1. From 1.2 to 2.3 seconds, Riley goes rigid. Her smile holds for one stunned beat while her eyes slide sideways, and her shoulders lift slightly under the capelet.
2. From 2.3 to 3.8 seconds, she slowly turns her head and shoulders back toward camera, past the spear butt, and up to the guard's closed helmet. Her face comes into three-quarter view in the rim light. The smile drains from her mouth, her lips press shut and her eyes widen behind her glasses. Her knuckles tighten on the staff.
3. From 3.8 to 5.17 seconds, she stops breathing and does not move. <Subject 6> stays completely still and silent, the spear butt still hovering at her elbow, his slotted helmet angled down at her.

Ending composition: the static wider shot holds Riley frozen against the wall in the mid-ground, staff clutched to her chest, staring up at the Second Guard. His shoulder and the reversed spear frame the left foreground, and the bright, empty alley mouth glows beyond them.

overall_soundscape:
Caught.
- Hushed alley stillness, with a faint muffled city murmur from the sunlit lane.
- One dull, light wooden tap of the spear butt against her leather sleeve.
- Riley's small, sharp intake of breath, then held silence.
- A soft creak of her leather capelet and a faint vial clink as she turns.
- A faint shift of the guard's fur and armor.

non_diegetic_music:
The playful pizzicato from the previous moment is cut off at the tap. A single deflating note follows: a low, muted brass tone that sags downward in pitch as her smile disappears. It then fades into silence for her frozen stare.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take, generated at 3.04 seconds and framed 16:9, with no cuts.

Camera:
- The camera is locked off at Riley's eye level, squarely frontal, in a close-up from just below her chin to just above the crown of her hood.
- It never pans, tilts, dollies or zooms.
- The lens has shallow depth of field.

Opening state:
- <Subject 1> fills the centre of the frame, facing the lens.
- Her brown leather hood is drawn low over her brow and casts a soft shadow across her forehead.
- Bright warm daylight falls on her cheeks, freckles and the tip of her nose.
- Her round silver glasses catch a small sun glint at their rims. Behind the lenses, her brown eyes are steady, narrowed slightly and determined.
- A few auburn strands escape the hood at her temples.
- At the bottom edge of the frame, the capelet's leather collar and the high violet bodice collar are visible, with the tops of two glowing blue vials.
- Behind her, the pale stone blocks of <Subject 2> and the soft edge of a black-and-crimson banner sit blurred in warm light.

Action, in order:
1. From 0 to 0.8 seconds, Riley holds still. She draws a slow, deliberate breath through her nose, her jaw firming and her eyes locked forward on the unseen guard. Her eyes do not dart.
2. From 0.8 to 1.8 seconds, she lifts her chin a fraction and, with quiet conviction, RILEY (S1) says <d>[English] Lovestruck.</d> Her lips shape the word clearly and her gaze never wavers. A faint confident tilt touches one corner of her mouth as she finishes.
3. From 1.8 to 3.04 seconds, she holds the look. A soft pink light begins to glow from below and around her. It warms her chin and cheeks, rims the edge of the hood, and blooms as small pink reflections in her glasses. Her expression stays resolved; only her eyes widen a hair as the light catches them.

Ending composition:
- The same frontal close-up of hooded Riley, determined, her face washed in a rising pink glow that is just beginning. The hood is still intact and no transformation has yet occurred.

overall_soundscape:
Resolve.
- A quiet open-air alley with a faint distant city murmur.
- A soft flutter of banner cloth.
- Riley's steadying breath before she speaks.
- A faint shimmering hum as the pink light begins to rise.

non_diegetic_music:
A bright synth riser that starts low under her breath, climbs through the spoken word and swells brighter as the pink glow appears. It is still rising, unresolved, at the end of the take.

Camera:
- The camera is locked off at a slightly low angle, roughly at hip height, tilted gently upward.
- It frames Riley in a three-quarter view, turned toward camera left, from just above her head to just below her feet.
- It never pans, tilts, dollies or zooms.

Opening state:
- <Subject 1> stands centred, slightly right of centre, with her weight even and her arms loose at her sides.
- Her brown leather hood is pulled low, and her glasses glint beneath its edge.
- The violet bodice, the glowing blue vials, the belt and pouches, the charcoal trousers and the buckled boots are all visible.
- A soft pink glow already lights her chin and cheeks.
- Behind her, the pale stone wall of <Subject 2> rises against the bright sky, with black-and-crimson banners hanging above her shoulder and iron-cornered crates at the wall's base.
- Warm daylight rakes across the cobbles.

Action, in order:
1. From 0 to 2 seconds, the pink glow swells from her chest outward. Riley's eyes lift, steady and expectant, and her fingers spread slightly.
2. From 2 to 4 seconds, the hood dissolves from its edge backward into drifting pink sparkles. This reveals her auburn hair and loose face-framing strands, and her glasses stay on. A lace-edged pink headband and heart earrings shimmer into place.
3. From 4 to 8 seconds, ribbons of pink light sweep down her body:
- The capelet unfurls into a sailor-style cape collar that lifts and settles.
- The bodice and vials melt into the asymmetrical silver-gray ruffled cropped top, and a glossy oversized pink heart blooms at her chest.
- The belt and trousers become high-waisted metallic hot-pink shorts over fitted black shorts, with heart-shaped hip armor edged in gold chevrons and translucent side panels.
- The boots resolve into magenta over-the-knee socks with pink zigzag bands, slouched white leg warmers and pink platform shoes.
- A pink choker and heart-patterned arm warmers appear last.
4. From 8 to 10.5 seconds, the light collapses inward into a few floating sparkles. The ruffles and the cape collar settle. Riley's hair shifts back into place.
5. From 10.5 to 12.25 seconds, she stands upright in the fading glow. Her arms hover slightly away from her body. She blinks once and glances down at herself, her lips parting in quiet surprise.

Ending composition:
- Riley stands full-figure in the new outfit, in the same three-quarter low-angle view.
- Faint pink sparkles dissipate against the grim stone and banners, and normal warm daylight returns.
- There is no dialogue.

overall_soundscape:
Candy-pink sparkle against grim stone.
- A quiet, open-air stone alley with a faint distant murmur from the city.
- An occasional flutter of banner cloth.
- A bright crystalline shimmer and a soft whoosh as the hood dissolves.
- Rippling fabric swishes and chimes as each garment forms.
- A small glossy ping as the chest heart blooms.
- Tinkling sparkles that thin away as the glow fades.
- Riley's light breath at the end.

non_diegetic_music:
An upbeat synth-pop transformation sting. It picks up the previous shot's rising energy, bursts into a bouncy bright groove with sparkling arpeggios as the outfit forms, and lands on a cheerful resolving chord as the glow fades.

detailed_description:

Camera:
- The camera is locked off above head height on Riley's right side, angled down at roughly thirty-five degrees.
- It holds a medium close-up from her hips to just above her headband. Her body is turned three-quarters toward camera left.
- It never pans, tilts, dollies or zooms.

Opening state:
- Her hands fill the lower centre of the frame, resting on the waistband of the high-waisted metallic hot-pink shorts. Her fingertips sit just below her bare midriff and the hem of the asymmetrical silver-gray ruffled top.
- The near heart-shaped hip armor, with its gold chevrons and a translucent side panel, catches the sun.
- Higher in the frame are the oversized glossy pink heart at her chest and the sailor-style cape collar spreading over her shoulders.
- White knit arm warmers with pink hearts cover her forearms.
- Her head is bowed, so the camera looks down past the lace-edged pink headband onto her glasses, freckles, pink heart earring, pink choker and the loose auburn strands beside her face.
- Below and behind her are warm sunlit cobbles, the base of the pale stone wall, the corner of an iron-cornered crate and the tail of a crimson-edged black banner.
- Warm daylight falls from upper left, and one or two last pink motes drift away and vanish.

Action, in order:
1. From 0 to 2 seconds, Riley's palms smooth the slick, unfamiliar fabric outward along the waistband toward her hips. The metallic surface creases and springs back. She pinches the edge of a translucent side panel between her finger and thumb and lets it go, unsure.
2. From 2 to 3.5 seconds, her right hand rises and tucks a loose auburn strand behind her right ear, brushing the dangling heart earring, while her eyes stay lowered.
3. From 3.5 to 5.5 seconds, she studies herself. Her gaze moves from the glossy heart down to the shorts. She turns her near hip slightly so the armor flashes gold, and her lips press together as one brow lifts, curious and a little self-conscious.
4. From 5.5 to 7.29 seconds, her expression settles and one corner of her mouth lifts faintly. Her hands lower to her sides. She raises her chin and looks up toward off-screen left, where the guard waits, and gives one small decisive nod.

Ending composition:
- The camera holds the same high side view. Riley's face is lifted toward camera left, her glasses catch the daylight and her hands rest at her sides.
- Her expression is quietly resolved.
- There is no dialogue.

overall_soundscape:
Self-conscious curiosity.
- A quiet, open-air stone alley with a faint distant murmur from the city.
- An occasional flutter of banner cloth.
- A soft, slick squeak of metallic fabric under her palms.
- A tiny crinkle as she pinches the side panel.
- A whisper of hair at her ear and the faint tick of the heart earring.
- A last faint sparkle tinkle fading at the start.
- Riley's small breath out before the nod.

non_diegetic_music:
The synth-pop softens. The bright transformation groove from the previous shot thins to a light, airy pad with a gentle plucked arpeggio. It lifts slightly on her decisive nod.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Riley (RILEY), age 24, the only person visible in this shot. She does not speak.
- <Picture 1> supplies her face: soft and pretty, with light freckles, brown eyes, straight dark brows, round silver wire-frame glasses and auburn hair. The hair is gathered into a short low ponytail with loose face-framing strands.
- <Video 2> confirms her face, glasses, freckles, hairline, ponytail and slim body proportions. It also supplies the construction and palette of her magical-girl look and its non-conflicting accessories: a lace-edged pink headband, glittery pink heart earrings, a pink heart choker and white knit arm warmers with pink hearts.
- Where <Video 2> differs from the authored outfit, the authored outfit wins. She wears a cropped silver-gray ruffled top, cut asymmetrically, beneath a dramatic sailor-style cape collar. An oversized glossy pink heart sits at her chest. Below it she wears high-waisted metallic hot-pink shorts over fitted black shorts, with heart-shaped hip armor edged in gold chevrons and translucent side panels. Her magenta over-the-knee socks with pink zigzag detailing fall below this frame.
- Her face, glasses, hair and outfit stay identical to the previous shot.
<Subject 2> is the sunlit main Noxian alley.
- <Picture 2> supplies the pale large-block stone walls, the black banners edged in crimson, the iron-cornered wooden crates, the barrels, the cobblestones and the bright, warm daylight.
- <Picture 3> supplies the stone texture, the banner tails and the crates at close range near the base of the wall.
- <Picture 4> supplies the opposite side of the alley, with arched doorways, barrels and the general cobble tone.
<Subject 3> is Riley's capped staff, propped against the wall where she left it.
- <Picture 5> supplies the staff body: a slim black scaled shaft with gold bands, a gold butt spike and gold flame-like prongs at the head.
- <Picture 7> supplies the dark iron anti-magic cap with red inlays, seated over that head so that no light shows.

summary:

The shot is framed from the off-screen guard's eyeline, so the camera stands where he stands. Riley stands facing him with her hands at her sides. She then raises both hands and makes a small heart shape at her chest, offering a hopeful, earnest smile straight into the lens. She ends holding the hand-heart and smiling.

- The stone, banners, crates, cobbles and warm daylight of <Subject 2>, from <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>.

- The motion blur from <Picture 4>.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take, generated at 4.46 seconds and framed 16:9, with no cuts.

Camera:
- The camera is locked off at the off-screen guard's standing eye height, directly in front of Riley, angled very slightly down toward her.
- It holds a frontal medium shot from just below the waistband of her shorts to a little above her headband, with Riley centred.
- It never pans, tilts, dollies or zooms.

Opening state:
- Riley stands square to camera with her arms relaxed at her sides. Her white knit arm warmers with pink hearts hang at the edges of her torso.
- The sailor-style cape collar spreads over her shoulders above the asymmetrical silver-gray ruffled top. The oversized glossy pink heart at her chest catches a bright highlight.
- A strip of bare midriff shows above the high-waisted metallic hot-pink shorts. The tops of the gold-chevron heart hip armor and the translucent side panels sit at the bottom edge of the frame.
- The lace-edged pink headband, the pink heart earrings, the choker, the round glasses and the freckles are crisp. Her auburn ponytail sits behind one shoulder, with loose strands at her cheeks and one strand still tucked behind her right ear.
- Behind her, slightly soft, is the pale block-stone wall of <Subject 2>, with a crimson-edged black banner hanging above her shoulder and iron-cornered crates at the wall's base.
- <Subject 3> leans against the wall at the right of the frame. Its dark iron cap is dull and its gold head is unlit.
- Warm daylight falls from upper left, putting a soft glint on her lenses.

Action, in order:
1. From 0 to 0.8 seconds, Riley meets the lens with an earnest, slightly uncertain look. She takes a small breath in, and her shoulders lift a fraction.
2. From 0.8 to 2.2 seconds, both hands rise together to the glossy heart at her chest. Her fingers curl and her thumbs meet, forming a small, neat hand-heart held just in front of the emblem. She is careful and a little shy about it.
3. From 2.2 to 3.2 seconds, a hopeful smile spreads across her face. Her cheeks lift, her eyes brighten behind the glasses and her head tilts very slightly to one side. She is offering the gesture to the guard as if it might genuinely work.
4. From 3.2 to 4.46 seconds, she holds still. The hand-heart stays raised at her chest, and her smile is steady and hopeful. Her eyes hold the lens, waiting for a reaction.

Ending composition:
- The camera holds the same frontal medium view.
- Riley holds the small hand-heart at her chest and smiles hopefully into the lens.
- There is no dialogue.

overall_soundscape:
Hopeful, earnest.
- A quiet open-air stone alley with a faint, distant murmur from the city.
- An occasional soft flutter of banner cloth.
- Riley's small intake of breath at the start.
- A faint rustle of knit arm warmers and a slick whisper of metallic fabric as her hands rise.
- A tiny pat as her fingertips meet.
- Near-silence while she holds the heart.

non_diegetic_music:
Twinkly chime. A single delicate, bright chime phrase sparkles as the hand-heart forms. It rings out softly and hangs in the air while she holds the smile.
